convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the ColorJVariation indicator (custom indicator, not built-in) and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trading logic (position open/close). Custom indicator parameters (JMA smoothing) cannot be replicated with built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose permissions control whether signal-reversal closes are allowed; SellPosClose=true closes short when long signal appears, BuyPosClose=true closes long when short signal appears

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size (abs value), positive values represent share of deposit fraction. Default MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lots

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals require two conditions: (1) ColorJVariation values show a directional change (Value[1]<Value[2] for uptrend or Value[1]>Value[2] for downtrend), and (2) the current signal bar confirms direction (Value[0]>Value[1] for long, Value[0]<Value[1] for short). The first condition checks if the indicator reversed between bars [2] and [1], and the second confirms the trend continues at bar [0]. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (bar index 1), not bar 0. Separate boolean input gates (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently control entry and exit permissions for each direction. The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on first tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: ColorJVariation is a custom JMA-smoothed variation indicator requiring either: (1) porting the ColorJVariation indicator source code to Python with JMA smoothing implementation, or (2) pre-computing indicator values in MT5 and exporting as CSV. The JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm (JLength=3, JPhase=100) is proprietary and requires careful implementation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position open/close with lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) and must be replicated. SL/TP are in points (not pips) and may need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers since no explicit adjustment is in the code. Signal logic reads 3 consecutive buffer values at offset SignalBar, comparing [1]vs[2] for trend direction and [0]vs[1] for confirmation. New bar detection via CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be reimplemented.
